name: Uzbekistan

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of blue, white and green separated by thin red lines, with a white crescent and twelve white stars in the upper hoist of the blue stripe.
flag.symbolism: Blue represents the sky and water, white peace, green nature and new life, and the red lines the life force; the crescent stands for independence and the twelve stars for the months of the year.

hook: Uzbekistan is blue-white-green with thin red lines and a crescent beside twelve stars, one for each month; Azerbaijan has a red middle stripe.
trivia: Uzbekistan is one of only two doubly landlocked countries in the world; the other is Liechtenstein.
Samarkand, a major city on the Silk Road, is more than 2,500 years old.
